mapper.sql: FROM tb_purchase_arrival_dt ad JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_hd ah ON ah.purchase_arrival_id = ad.purchase_arrival_id AND ah.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_dt od ON od.purchase_order_detail_id = ad.purchase_order_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = ah.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = ah.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = ad.material_id AND m.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ins ON ins.purchase_arrival_detail_id = ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id WHERE ad.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ad.inspect_at = 'Y' AND ah.use_at = 'Y' AND ad.arrival_qty - COALESCE(ins.pass_qty, 0) - COALESCE(ins.fail_qty, 0) > 0
mapper.select:
SELECT ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id AS purchaseArrivalDetailId, ah.purchase_arrival_id AS purchaseArrivalId, ah.arrival_no AS arrivalNo, ah.arrival_dt AS arrivalDt, c.customer_name AS supplierName, ad.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, oh.order_no AS orderNo, ad.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, ad.arrival_qty AS arrivalQty, COALESCE(ins.pass_qty, 0) + COALESCE(ins.fail_qty, 0) AS inspectedQty, COALESCE(ins.pass_qty, 0) AS passQty, COALESCE(ins.fail_qty, 0) AS failQty, ad.arrival_qty - COALESCE(ins.pass_qty, 0) - COALESCE(ins.fail_qty, 0) AS waitQty
AND ah.arrival_dt >= CAST(#{fromDt} AS date)
AND ah.arrival_dt <= CAST(#{toDt} AS date)
AND (c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{supplierKeyword} || '%' OR c.customer_code ILIKE '%' || #{supplierKeyword} || '%')
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%' OR m.material_spec ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%')
AND (ah.arrival_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR oh.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY ah.arrival_dt DESC, ah.arrival_no DESC, ad.line_no LIMIT 500

SELECT ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id AS purchaseArrivalDetailId, ad.purchase_arrival_id AS purchaseArrivalId, ah.arrival_no AS arrivalNo, ah.use_at AS arrivalUseAt, ad.inspect_at AS inspectAt, ad.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, ad.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, ad.arrival_qty AS arrivalQty, COALESCE(ins.pass_qty, 0) + COALESCE(ins.fail_qty, 0) AS inspectedQty FROM tb_purchase_arrival_dt ad JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_hd ah ON ah.purchase_arrival_id = ad.purchase_arrival_id AND ah.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = ad.material_id AND m.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ins ON ins.purchase_arrival_detail_id = ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id WHERE ad.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id IN #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id
FOR UPDATE OF ad

SELECT ih.quality_inspection_id AS qualityInspectionId, ih.inspection_no AS inspectionNo, ih.inspection_dt AS inspectionDt, ih.inspector_id AS inspectorId, ih.use_at AS useAt FROM tb_quality_inspection_hd ih WHERE ih.quality_inspection_id = #{qualityInspectionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ih.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE OF ih
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_quality_inspection_hd SET inspection_dt = CAST(#{inspectionDt} AS date), inspector_id = #{inspectorId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, inspector_dept_id = #{inspectorDeptId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE quality_inspection_id = #{qualityInspectionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'

UPDATE tb_quality_inspection_hd SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE quality_inspection_id = #{qualityInspectionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT ih.quality_inspection_id AS qualityInspectionId, ih.inspection_no AS inspectionNo, ih.inspection_dt AS inspectionDt, ih.inspector_id AS inspectorId, u.user_nm AS inspectorName, ih.remark AS remark, ih.use_at AS useAt, CASE WHEN ih.use_at = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'CANCELED' END AS status, ih.created_by AS createdBy, ih.created_at AS createdAt, ih.updated_by AS updatedBy, ih.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tb_quality_inspection_hd ih LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = ih.inspector_id WHERE ih.quality_inspection_id = #{qualityInspectionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ih.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT idt.quality_inspection_detail_id AS qualityInspectionDetailId, idt.line_no AS lineNo, idt.purchase_arrival_detail_id AS purchaseArrivalDetailId, ad.purchase_arrival_id AS purchaseArrivalId, (ah.use_at = 'Y') AS arrivalLinked, idt.arrival_no AS arrivalNo, c.customer_name AS supplierName, idt.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, oh.order_no AS orderNo, idt.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, ad.arrival_qty AS arrivalQty, COALESCE(oth.inspected_qty, 0) AS otherInspectedQty, ad.arrival_qty - COALESCE(oth.inspected_qty, 0) AS maxQty, idt.pass_qty AS passQty, idt.fail_qty AS failQty, idt.pass_qty + idt.fail_qty AS inspectQty, COALESCE((SELECT sum(rd.receipt_qty) FROM tb_purchase_receipt_dt rd JOIN tb_purchase_receipt_hd rh ON rh.purchase_receipt_id = rd.purchase_receipt_id AND rh.tenant_id = rd.tenant_id WHERE rd.quality_inspection_detail_id = idt.quality_inspection_detail_id AND rh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND rh.use_at = 'Y'), 0) AS receivedQty, (SELECT rh.receipt_no FROM tb_purchase_receipt_dt rd JOIN tb_purchase_receipt_hd rh ON rh.purchase_receipt_id = rd.purchase_receipt_id AND rh.tenant_id = rd.tenant_id WHERE rd.quality_inspection_detail_id = idt.quality_inspection_detail_id AND rh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND rh.use_at = 'Y' ORDER BY rh.purchase_receipt_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS receiptNo, idt.remark AS remark FROM tb_quality_inspection_dt idt LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_dt ad ON ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id = idt.purchase_arrival_detail_id LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_hd ah ON ah.purchase_arrival_id = ad.purchase_arrival_id AND ah.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = ah.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = ah.tenant_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_dt od ON od.purchase_order_detail_id = idt.purchase_order_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = idt.material_id AND m.tenant_id = idt.tenant_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.purchase_arrival_detail_id AS purchase_arrival_detail_id, sum(o.pass_qty + o.fail_qty) AS inspected_qty FROM tb_quality_inspection_dt o JOIN tb_quality_inspection_hd oi ON oi.quality_inspection_id = o.quality_inspection_id AND oi.tenant_id = o.tenant_id WHERE oi.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND oi.use_at = 'Y' AND o.quality_inspection_id <> #{qualityInspectionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND o.purchase_arrival_detail_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.purchase_arrival_detail_id) oth ON oth.purchase_arrival_detail_id = idt.purchase_arrival_detail_id WHERE idt.quality_inspection_id = #{qualityInspectionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND idt.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY idt.line_no
